reviews.t: My only issue with these is that they are more ...
reviews.x: My only issue with these is that they are more vertical than they are shown in the pictures which makes them not what I was looking for - which was a small container to hold home made body butters. Because they are tall and thin, about 1.5" wide and 2.5" tall, they are just OK for my needs. I was hoping for a more wide, less tall proportion.

reviews.t: Perfect for carrying small amounts of liquid
reviews.x: I use these to keep little containers of coconut oil in my car, gym bag, work, etc.  Coconut oil (good for moisturizing lips, hands, face) is solid up until 76 degrees or so, so I needed something that won't leak in various temperatures.  These fit the bill!
These were long skinny containers not wide mouth as shown. Boooooo.

LOVE these. I used them for body butter. I've purchased body butter at craft fairs, usually in these same containers. At craft fairs the body butters are very expensive, and I decided to make my own. But of all the ingredients I had to buy, the containers were the MOST expensive and most difficult to choose!  Normally body butter is in larger, 4-ounce jars but these smaller jars are a great size for a harder butter to use on lips and hands, and to keep in your purse or car. The screw lid is secu

reviews.t: Great product, different product when shipped
reviews.x: These are great! I make homemade salves an they are perfect! although I did want these boxy sqaure looking ones when what I got was a softer edged, more round container. Just keep an eye out amazon products may have small writing sayin " product may be different than pictured". kind of irritates me they do that! just be aware. great containers though!
Use these jars to old coconut oil and lotions in for my infant, they are a good size and the lids are easy to get on and off.

These jars are awesome! I use them for storing homemade toothpaste, homemade deodorant, and whipped coconut oil infused with lavender oil. My homemade toothpaste and deodorant is simply coconut oil mixed with baking soda yet these jars are always easy to clean with dish soap despite storing oils for months at a time. The oil washes out fast and easily every time! The plastic is very durable and I know they will last for many years. The lids are easy to open and never have any problems screwing t

The containers I received weren't even close to what was pictured. Tall skinny containers, not wide. Useless to me as is. Will not work for any of my intended uses, such as ointment, as stated in title. Item is closer to a pill container than an ointment container. I'm very disappointed as this product is utterly useless and a complete waste of money.

reviews.t: LOVE!! Three amazing uses: protein powder, travel liquids, parking change.
reviews.x: These little jars are amazing!! I've found three great uses for them so far:  1. These are the erfect size for a single serving of protein powder or Vega One!! I fill up a bunch of these and keep them everywhere (gym bag, carry-on suitcase, office)  2. Great for liquids and gloopy things when travelling (hair conditioner, face wash, etc).  3. Also use for keeping parking meter coins in the car!  At about 50 cents each, you just can't go wrong. When I travel with multiple liquids, I just write on

2oz is the perfect size - about as big as a baby's fist.  The twist cap keeps it sealed well so I can leave it in the bathroom without worrying about mold or melting/leaking or anything.  I've been using them for oil + shea butter moisturizers. I wanted something I could leave in the shower for shaving butter - these jars work perfectly. As long as your hand is dry when you take butter out, no water will get in.  Zero complaints.

I have used these containers to make balms and salves.  They work wonderfully.  The threading on the bottle makes the caps easy to open and close.  They are the perfect size to get your fingers into the bottle or use a small spatula as to not contaminate the contents.  They were shipped extra fast and I would suggest these to others and I have already purchased more!

The containers I received are more narrow than pictured.  They measure approx. 1-5/8" wide and 2-3/8" tall.  Diameter of the lid is 1-7/8".  My order was from Glass Bottle Outlet with fulfillment by Amazon.  I would have preferred wider shorter containers, but they seem to be well made, and they should be handy for traveling.

reviews.t: I made some lotion and these jars were perfect to store it in
reviews.x: I made some lotion and these jars were perfect to store it in! They are nice and dark so the sun can't get through and they have nice liners on the top of the lids to help keep things fresh. I would order from this company again if needed. Delivered on time and I had no issues with any of the jars or lids.

The Youth of my church used these jars to put lotion that they made for the Mothers of our Church for Mother's day.  They were a hit.  Just the right size to keep in the purse.  The Mothers loved it.  Would order them again for other craft projects that requires jars with lids.  The lids fit great.

I am starting to use essential oils. I am wanting to create creams and ointments. I was looking for ointment jars with lids. This vendor offered 1/2 oz, 1 oz and 2 oz sizes. They delivered as promised and I received exactly what I ordered. Product looks solid and will hopefully prove reliable.

reviews.t: These work great for my homemade salve
reviews.x: These work great for my homemade salve! The only reason I gave them 4 stars instead of 5, is even with permanent marker, anything you try to write on them for labeling, wipes right off, but the sticker labels don't come off as easy!

reviews.t: but have worked perfect for my homemade lotions
reviews.x: Arrived quickly and work well. The kids can seem to be a little loose but with a solid lotion inside I have not noticed any leaking.  They are thin and light weight, but have worked perfect for my homemade lotions.

reviews.t: Plastic Ointment Jars With Lids 2 Oz 10/pkg ...
reviews.x: The picture shows jars with lower height.  Jars arrived with narrow diameter and longer body [height].  Will not reorder again jars from GBO.  Kindly read through feed backs; I'm not the only not happy with order.
These seem taller to me than they look in the picture.  I would say it's similar to old 35mm film containers (for those old enough to remember 😊) but slightly bigger.  I am happy with this item.
I like them for the reason they hold up well when you are pouring very hot liquids into them.I like the doudle wall construction on the jars. It makes them easy to handle when they are hot.

reviews.t: Good quality. I used mine for homemade deodorant storage
reviews.x: Good quality. I used mine for homemade deodorant storage, which melts when warm due to the coconut oil.  Liquid does deep out even when closed tightly. That reduced the rating by one star
Good and sturdy containers. I did not have to worry about filling them with hot liquid, and they can survive drops and other accidents without fear of cracking. Will definitely buy again.

reviews.t: Love them, except that they are plastic
reviews.x: Solid product. Love them, except that they are plastic. I just didn't want to spend the money on glass because I planned on giving some of the salve I made and poured in them away.
I used these jars for homemade body butter.  The quality of the jars is fine, no sharp edges or manufacturing defects.  Jars seal tightly.  I just wish they were a little cheaper.
These were packaged well and arrived on time.  I would definitely order them again.  I am using them for making homemade lotions and to give out to friends.  These are perfect!

claims.text: Many reviewers find these jars perfect for homemade lotions, body butters, salves, and balms.
Several reviewers report the containers received are taller and narrower than pictured, not the wide-mouth shape shown.
Reviewers praise the lids for sealing well and being easy to open and close.
The 2-ounce size is described as convenient and just right for travel, purses, and small portions.
Some reviewers note the jars are durable and easy to clean.
